description: This script provides utility functions for running the WebKit Playwright application on different operating systems (MacOS and Linux). It determines paths for dependencies and executes the application with appropriate environment settings based on the platform.

methods.name: getWebkitCheckoutPath
methods.description: Returns the WebKit checkout path, defaulting to '$HOME/webkit' if not set.

methods.name: runOSX
methods.description: Configures environment variables and executes the Playwright application on MacOS systems.

methods.name: runLinux
methods.description: Configures environment variables and executes the MiniBrowser application on Linux systems, with support for headless mode.
